_instructions: Copy this file to local.settings.json (gitignored) and fill in your values.
You must also set the corresponding GAS script properties in the Apps Script editor:
Apps Script → Project Settings → Script Properties → Add property
INITIAL_FOLDER_ID     = same value as initialFolderId below
GAS_LOGGER_FOLDER_ID  = Drive folder ID of the folder referenced by gasLogDir below
To find a Drive folder ID: open the folder in Google Drive,
copy the alphanumeric ID from the URL:
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/<FOLDER_ID_HERE>
gasLogDir must be the local filesystem path where Google Drive for Desktop
maps the GAS_LOGGER_FOLDER_ID folder.
initialFolderPath must be the local filesystem path where Google Drive for Desktop
maps the INITIAL_FOLDER_ID folder. Used by Playwright tests to determine which
subfolder actually contains audio tracks, avoiding empty or archive folders.
Axiom is optional (used by query-axiom.py and GasLogger.flush()'s exclusive
POST once configured). axiomToken is the INGEST token (write-only, set as the
GAS script property AXIOM_TOKEN); axiomQueryToken is a separate READ-ONLY token
used only by query-axiom.py / gas-log-helpers.js. Get both from the Axiom org's
Settings -> API Tokens page. Without these, GasLogger still works -- it just
writes Drive NDJSON only.
webappTestUrl/webappSecret are required only for gas-log-helpers.js's
axiomProbeLatency/assertNoLog sentinel-watermark helpers (see README.md
'Sentinel-Watermark Waits'). They point at a deployment/test-only WebApp route
that calls GasLogger.log('test.axiom_probe', {sentinel}) + flush() -- the probe
must go through the real GAS->Axiom path, not a test-process-direct-to-Axiom
shortcut, or it would understate real ingest latency.
